scope: Independent manual visual verification of rendered actual UAT PDFs, not developer tests or a text-extraction-only assertion

preconditions: Actual authenticated UAT PDF generated at attested SHA
Owned synthetic case text verified through API
PDF rendered with PyMuPDF and independently inspected visually
steps: Visually compare mixed title with input including Arabic shaping,Latin runs,digits,punctuation and line continuation
results.expected_results: Connected Arabic, preserved Latin Alpha/Beta/AB-123 and digit sequence; correct reading order with wrapping; no mirrored Latin characters
results.actual: Both rendered pages inspected. MIX0 Arabic-first Alpha/123/2026 order preserved; MIX1 AB-123/Beta/(2025) preserved; MIX2 English-first Alpha123 and Arabic continuation456 legible and correctly ordered.

steps: Inspect first-column position,localized headers,landscape table and second-page continuation
